premises.text: Cross-border remittances suffer lost funds, delays, high cost, and low transparency
premises.evidence_span: Lost funds, delayed delivery of funds, high cost, low transparency

premises.text: Mobile app integrates with employer payroll so employees can send payroll funds cross-border, top up phones, and pay international bills
premises.evidence_span: integrates with an employer's payroll system and allows employees to send payroll funds cross-border, top up mobile phones, and pay international bills

premises.text: Transfers are priced as little as $1 to $4 plus FX, far below typical competitor fees
premises.evidence_span: We charge as little as $1, where our competitors are charging $5, $15 and up

premises.text: Direct central-bank connections and ATM partnerships create instant interoperable payout rails
premises.evidence_span: We have built a direct connection to the Central Bank of Mexico, which allows us to do an instant transfer to Mexican bank accounts

premises.text: Combining payroll with a money-service business shifts user behavior and reduces regulatory and customer-acquisition costs
premises.evidence_span: We combine payroll with money service business, and in so doing, shift user behavior, reduce regulatory costs, and reduce customer acquisition costs

premises.text: Distribution is through banks, payroll providers, and employers, shifting the payer from employee to employer
premises.evidence_span: We distribute the products to banks, payroll providers, and direct to employers

value.text: Employees get high-transparency, lower-cost cross-border payroll transfers
value.evidence_span: a solution that is high transparency, lower cost

secondary_value.text: Recipients keep more of remitted funds as transfer costs fall
secondary_value.evidence_span: With each 1% reduction in the cost of international transfers, $6 billion goes into the hands of recipients

causal_links.evidence_span: a solution that is high transparency, lower cost
allows us to do an instant transfer to Mexican bank accounts
reduce regulatory costs, and reduce customer acquisition costs

notes: Singleton D2 and D4 retained: rails and problem framing are separately revisable from payroll product and channel model. FDIC-insured wallet detail folded into payroll product. Team bios and financing excluded. Driving cost to zero via VAS treated as vision (§4.1(4)).
